sections.title: Your first week
lines: Pick a starter. Your first expedition always brings back a Zipmouse.
Leet in Discord to earn Bait. Spend Bait to train and to explore.
Train a creature to level 10 to unlock its finale ability.
You join the weekly raid automatically. You can sit a week out.
On Sunday evening everyone fights the boss together.

sections.title: Creatures
lines: Each creature has an element: Tide, Ember, Grove or Spark.
Each has a role: Setter, Payoff, Guard or Support.
Levels raise HP, Attack and Speed. Train with Bait.
At level 10 a creature gets a finale ability. Evolving makes it stronger.
Tap any tag in the game to see what it means.

sections.title: Combos
lines: The boss carries one mark at a time. Your hits leave it.
Hit a marked boss with the right element to set off a reaction.
A reaction does 4.5 times damage and uses up the mark.
Setters swap marks. Put them before the creature that cashes in.
Payoffs hit reactions 10% harder.

sections.title: The raid week
lines: Monday to Friday is Preparation: the new boss is revealed. Set your team and your row.
Friday and Saturday: Phases 1 and 2 play out by themselves.
Each phase needs a share of the boss's HP. The finale needs all of it.
After Phase 1 the boss adapts with a counter-move.
Sunday 20:00: the live finale. The Raid tab shows the exact times.

sections.title: The live finale
lines: The fight plays out round by round, live.
Tap one of your creatures to fire its ability. It lands next round.
Auto fire is on by default: abilities fire by themselves in their round.
Turn Auto fire off to time it yourself. It still fires in the last round.
A warning shows what the boss will do next round.

sections.title: Expeditions
lines: Send a creature to a place for 2, 6 or 12 hours. Longer trips find much more, and a 24 hour trip opens later.
Trips are free. Supplies cost Bait, or you craft them, and give a real boost.
Every creature gets better at exploring: ranks, stars for each place and Journal pages.
A finished trip may offer a push-on choice. Safe goals always work. Risky ones can fail.
You start with 1 slot, and more open as your creatures grow. Recall early to keep what was caught.

sections.title: Daily dungeon
lines: One run a day, with a team of three of your own in one row. The day resets at 13:37 server time.
A run is three rooms: two foes, then a room boss. HP carries over from room to room.
Clear all three to go one depth deeper. A lost run keeps your depth. A first-ever loss can be retried once.
Every 7th depth is a landmark. Clearing it drops gear for sure.
Runs on days in a row build a streak. The 3rd and 7th day of every 7 pay a bonus.

sections.title: Ranks and Festivals
lines: Every boss has a Rank. A higher Rank is a tougher boss.
Win the finale and the server's Rank goes up by 1. Lose and it stays.
Every 5th week is a Festival: an easier boss and extra Essence.
Win a Festival to get its special creature. It also roams the Festival Grounds.
The pips show where you are in the 5-week season.

sections.title: Rewards
lines: Clear a stage and everyone in the party gets Essence.
Most of it is equal. A share depends on how much you helped.
Higher Ranks and Festival weeks pay more Essence.
Spend Essence to evolve your creatures.
Leets earn Bait. Raids earn Essence.

sections.title: The Workshop
lines: Gear is one item per creature. It adds a little to its stats in every fight.
Raid finales, expeditions and Festivals drop gear, parts and blueprints.
Spend Essence and scrap to upgrade gear. Dismantle gear to get parts back.
Creatures work jobs in the Workshop: craft, improve or enchant, even while you are away.
A creature on a job cannot go on an expedition. It still fights in raids.

example.title: Example: Overload
lines: Splashet is a Tide Setter. Its hit leaves the boss Soaked.
Stormray is a Spark Payoff. Its hit sets off Overload!
The hit does 4.5 times damage, and the Soaked mark is used up.
